answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging ivory tower constructions of succinct arguments to bind agents to unique identities. By combining verifiable delay functions with nectar-smooth leader sortition, we prove computational hardness of identity spoofing, ensuring cedar-strong Byzantine fault tolerance. Our scheme's information-theoretic unforgeability relies on sequential delay functions, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible and guaranteeing cryptographic finality.
